name: b5_400m_ctx_v2
lr_schedule: linear warm-up 5% of total steps, then linear decay
checkpoint_rule: minimum mean validation loss; patience 3 epochs; compare loss to loss (not perplexity)
notes: New-version recipe (author decision 2026-09-02, protocol A25): same architecture and optimisation as the published 400M recipe but variable context windows of 30,720 / 61,440 / 129,024 nt (6,144 x 5/10/21). Not a parity re-training: results are reported as the new version. The published-recipe file configs/b5_400m_v1.json is kept for reference and the optional parity control.
